subject: How to run sparkR jobs on CDH5 with MR1 libraries--- Ubantu 12.4

messages.author: bd6189f98258d60d
messages.subject: How to run sparkR jobs on CDH5 with MR1 libraries--- Ubantu 12.4
parts:
Hi, 

I need to know, what steps to run sparkR on MR1 CDH5 cluster. As per I understood from internet below are the things I need to make out:

> get the sparkR  source repository from github 
>  install  R by setting  appropriate hadoop libs. In case of CDH5 it should be SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION=2.3.0-mr1-cdh5.1.3 ./install-dev.sh 

are these the only things I need to take care? or are there any other configuration I should make in cluster? 

some backgrounds if any one needed : I tried running spark jobs on local mode it works fine, then i master master as yarn because the default CDH5 cluster manager is yarn but it fails to recognize the master URL  

please let me know if something I miss out to explain what i want to achieve. 

Thanks,

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: How to run sparkR jobs on CDH5 with MR1 libraries--- Ubantu 12.4
parts:
Hi 

The only other thing to set would be to point SPARK_HOME to the right directory before launching SparkR. I wrote up a gist sometime back for installing and running SparkR on CDH5 in a EC2 environment https://gist.github.com/shivaram/9240335 and the last bit about running SparkR might be useful.

Thanks
Shivaram

messages.author: efd41a47b8810539
messages.subject: Re: How to run sparkR jobs on CDH5 with MR1 libraries--- Ubantu 12.4
parts:
Hi Shiva, 

Thanks for replying. In CDH5 I was couple of issue and it kill time to debug and fix the issue. because of time limitation I installed sparkR in Apcahe Spark cluster and it ir runnig fine. Few highlights I need to mention :
> Make changes in SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION ?= 2.4.1 and used maven as build tool 
> copy sparkR-pkg directory to workers node in same path {in case its not correct, user will get worker.R doesnt exist in worker log file }
>    to run : SPARK_HOME=/usr/lib/spark /home/user/SparkR-pkg-master/sparkR /home/user/SparkR-pkg-master/examples/pi.R spark://<master>:<port>    

Just to understand more, each each worker also need "sparkR package" for processing or it only take help of .R files and execute directly on R ?  and how we deiced what should be the driver memory and executor memory for any application?  

Cheers,

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: How to run sparkR jobs on CDH5 with MR1 libraries--- Ubantu 12.4
parts:
Each worker needs the SparkR package as it we usually have references to things like Broadcast variables that are only available in the package. So just the R files will not be enough.

Regd driver vs. executor memory, that is more general Spark question and also depends on your application. You could try to post some details about your application to Spark's user mailing list to see if other users have any guidance.

Thanks
Shivaram
